comparison.objective: Hitch a loaded trailer by supporting its tongue, moving the rover beneath it, and lowering it onto the ball; no spec versions are available.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load support, vehicle positioning, and socket-on-ball alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Trailer is hitched through the stated support-and-lower sequence; load, alignment, and latch thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Heavy-load support and hitch mating are materially different from precision mandrel alignment, hammer fracture, and fragment collection.
